description: Fixed-position container that renders toast notifications from the injected ToastService. Supports four screen positions and auto-dismiss with animated progress bars.

parameters.name: Position
parameters.description: Position of the toast container on screen.

parameters.name: MaxVisible
parameters.description: Maximum number of toasts visible at once.

parameters.name: PauseOnHover
parameters.description: Pause the auto-dismiss timer while the pointer hovers a toast or focus is inside it (mouseenter/focusin pause, mouseleave/focusout resume with the remaining time). A hidden document pauses every toast regardless of this setting.

parameters.name: MinActionDuration
parameters.description: Minimum duration (milliseconds) for toasts carrying an action button (e.g. Undo): a shorter requested duration is floored to this value so the action stays reachable long enough to react. Pushed to ToastService.MinActionDuration when parameters are set (set it before showing toasts). Sticky toasts (duration <= 0) and toasts without an action are never floored.
